comparison.objective: Roll a knife and fork inside a cloth napkin; candidate adjusts and locks a rigid gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires deformable-cloth edge acquisition, wrapping, regrasping, and containment of loose cutlery, not rigid coaxial tool use and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks cutlery alignment, napkin enclosure/winding and bundle width with a 5 s stable hold; candidate checks calibrated angle, nuts, cycles, drift, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: The deformable wrapping ability has no meaningful overlap with mechanical stop calibration beyond generic bimanual manipulation.
